role: Real usage-budget enforcement — turn count, token count, session duration checked against real, configurable limits. The exact 'no runaway philosophical discussion' governor requested; a real hard stop, not a suggestion.
behaviorDescription: checkSession() checks real usage state against real limits, verified against within-limit and over-limit cases before implementation. No LLM needed — fully deterministic threshold enforcement.
hardStops: Never allows a session past a real, exceeded limit
Never fabricates a usage number not derived from real session state
